title: Geometry of Confabulation and Refusal in Small Language Models
abstract: arXiv:2611.01272v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Faced with an unanswerable question, small language models can either refuse or confabulate: confidently produce a wrong answer. Can the hidden state before the first generated token provide a clue? Can we flip confabulations into refusals? I introduce ConfabQA, a 784-item benchmark whose obscure-pre-cutoff category breaks the typical correctness/knowledge-cutoff confound and map the geometry of the hidden state with linear probes, a sparse autoencoder (SAE), and direct optimization of intervention directions. On Qwen3-1.7B and Gemma 2 2B the probe separates upcoming refusals from confabulations well beyond prompt features (+7.4/+16.3 pp); on Llama 3.2 3B the ConfabQA margin is within fold-to-fold spread, but a direct refusal probe on PopQA and TriviaQA recovers +18-25 pp. On Qwen I closely inspect three candidate directions for the refusal vector: probe-recovered, Qwen-Scope SAE feature, and directly optimized. translated_title: 小型语言模型中虚构与拒绝的几何结构
translated_abstract: 面对无法回答的问题时，小型语言模型要么选择拒绝回答，要么进行“虚构”（confabulate）——即自信地给出一个错误答案。第一个生成 token 之前的隐藏状态能否提供线索？我们能否将虚构行为转变为拒绝行为？本文提出了 ConfabQA——一个包含 784 个条目的基准，其“截止日期前模糊”类别打破了正确性与知识截止日期之间常见的混淆因素，并借助线性探针、稀疏自编码器（SAE）以及对干预方向的直接优化来刻画隐藏状态的几何结构。在 Qwen3-1.7B 和 Gemma 2 2B 上，探针区分即将发生的拒绝与虚构的能力远超提示特征（分别提升 +7.4 和 +16.3 个百分点）；在 Llama 3.2 3B 上，ConfabQA 上的差距处于折间波动范围内，但在 PopQA 和 TriviaQA 上使用直接拒绝探针可恢复 +18-25 个百分点。在 Qwen 上，作者详细考察了拒绝向量的三个候选方向：探针恢复的方向、Qwen-Scope SAE 特征方向以及直接优化的方向。尽管这三个方向……（原文摘要在此处截断）
tldr: 该研究提出 ConfabQA 基准，通过线性探针、稀疏自编码器和干预方向优化揭示了小型语言模型在不可回答问题上“自信虚构”与“拒绝回答”背后的隐藏状态几何特征，并证明可以在生成之前预测甚至将虚构行为转化为拒绝行为。
en_tdlr: This paper introduces ConfabQA, a benchmark using linear probes, sparse autoencoders, and optimized intervention directions to reveal the geometry of hidden states that determine whether small language models confabulate or refuse on unanswerable questions, enabling refusals to be predicted—and confabulations potentially converted into refusals—before generation begins.
